newsitem.title: USA: Lockheed to sell commercial electroncis unit.
newsitem.headline: Lockheed to sell commercial electroncis unit.

text.p: Lockheed Martin Corp said Monday it agreed to sell its Commercial Electronics operation to Manufacturers' Services Ltd for undisclosed terms.
The transaction is expected to be completed in October, Lockheed's statement continued. Its spokesmen were not immediately available to elaborate.

It did say Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp, an affiliate of DLJ Merchant Banking Partners, will provide financing for the acquisition. The Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette merchant banking affiliate is also a majority owner of Manufacturers' Services.

The acquisition of the Hudson, N.H., operation moves Manufacturers' Services to 4th-largest from 8th-largest among the world's electronics manufacturing services companies, Lockeed's statement said. It establishes a manufacturing operation for the company in the eastern U.S. and gives its global customers local access to an important market.
The acquisition is Manufacturers' Services' sixth since its founding in 1994 and positions the company to achieve nearly $1 billion in revenue in 1997, Lockheed said.
All of Lockheed Martin Commercial Electronics' more than 700 employees will join Manufacturers' Services, which will now have over 3,000 employees worldwide.
